text:
Samir (PM): Putting a pin in scope for Reserved Pools GA — need to finalize which customer contract asks are non-negotiable vs. deferred. Also need a defensible autoscale fallback guardrail for Sales to quote.

Ivy (Eng-Platform): Tech constraints summary: 1) token-bucket per tenant (refill = commit_qps * window_s), 2) fallback chain implemented in routing layer, 3) autoscale min/max tied to commitment. We can expose a single toggle: prefer-quality vs prefer-availability.

Rina (Customer Success): Pilots want three things in contract: explicit burst window, visible fallback banner in Console, and opt-out for automatic model downgrade on sensitive routes. They may sign if we include a moderate SLA line.

Diego (Eng-SRE): Ops asks: telemetry (headroom_pct, fallback.count, fallback.duration), alert: fallback.duration > 2m -> page, and a chaos test (6m burst + node preempt). Default queue cap 120ms. We should tag traces with fallback.reason and model_variant.

Tom (Legal): On SLA language: we can offer conservative operational guarantees. Financial credits are risky for GA; recommend ops-remediation + support credit. We can add a pilot-specific SLA addendum if Sales needs more.

Samir (PM): Decision point: carryover (5% vs 10%), whether to allow prewarm micro-pools, and whether console banner is MUST or pilot-only feature-flag. Thoughts?

Ivy (Eng-Platform): Carryover 10% smooths traffic; low dev cost. Prewarm micro-pools increase cost/ops complexity — skip for MVP. Banner: implement as feature-flag for pilots so Sales can enable per-contract.

Rina (Customer Success): Feature-flag is fine as long as Pilot A gets banner enabled. They also want an "escalate to CS" CTA on the banner.

Diego (Eng-SRE): We'll add a pilot-flag for the banner and ensure a runbook link on the banner. Also add metric burst_credit_depletion with 1m/5m windows.

Samir (PM): Autoscale guardrail proposal for docs (simple JSON snippet): {"policy":"mvp","scale_up_pct":0.8,"scale_down_pct":0.35,"min_replicas":2,"max_replicas":"commit_base*3","burst_window_s":300,"fallback_order":["quantized","smaller","queue"],"queue_ms":120}. Use this as the default unless tenant overrides in contract.

Ivy (Eng-Platform): I'll submit PR with that schema + token-bucket math and mapping table (commit_tier -> multiplier).

Tom (Legal): I'll draft fallback contract language that states: "During saturation Redwood may route to a lower-fidelity model or temporarily queue requests; customers will be notified and may opt-out for specified routes." Keep opt-out process manual for GA.

Rina (Customer Success): I'll collect pilot redlines and confirm banner enablement. If Pilot B insists on financial credits, escalate to Sales.

Diego (Eng-SRE): Additive to PR: alert rules, chaos checklist, and traces instrumentation. Also we should store fallback.reason histogram for 30d.

Samir (PM): GA gates: MUST = allocation API, token-bucket implementation, fallback routing, pilot-banner feature-flag, basic telemetry + alerts, legal fallback clause drafted. SHOULD = self-serve quota edits, per-route opt-outs in UI. Gate to GA: 2 pilot signoffs OR 48h stable pilot telemetry (fallback rate <2%).

ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-1999 "Reserved pool GA fences + contract fallback" assigned to Samir/Ivy/Diego/Rina/Tom. Due 1717783600.

Ivy (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup: will open PR by Thu.

Rina (Customer Success): :eyes: chasing Pilot A for sign-off.

Diego (Eng-SRE): :thumbsup: will add chaos tests.

Tom (Legal): :thumbsup: will share draft by EOD.

Samir (PM): Thanks team. 10m standup tomorrow 09:45 to confirm PR link and pilot banner flag.
